name: Frostpeak Outpost
description: A small mining outpost built where the foothill road meets the high pass. Its stone buildings huddle around a windbreak of stacked ore crates and old timbers.

gate.name: Frostpeak Road Gate
gate.description: A stout timber gate marks the end of the maintained foothill road. Beyond it, a drifted track leads into the high mountains; inside, lamps burn behind oiled horn panes.

supply_yard.name: Frostpeak Supply Yard
supply_yard.description: Sledges, rope coils, and sealed food barrels sit beneath a rough awning. A forge glows to the east, while the Mining Lodge keeps its door open against the cold. A board beside the bunkhouse carries the day's haul and the names of miners overdue from shift.

forge.name: Outpost Forge
forge.description: A practical stone forge fills this low building with the smell of coal and hot iron. Most of the work here is repair work: pitons, picks, and the occasional blade.

mining_lodge.name: Frostpeak Mining Lodge
mining_lodge.description: The Lodge's common room is plain but warm. Maps of old workings are pinned beside names of people who did not return, and a long table has room for any miner willing to share news. A notice board by the door carries work posted from the outpost and the road below.

mine_office.name: Mine Office
mine_office.description: Shelves of survey tubes and battered ledgers fill this narrow room. A relief map of the high country is marked with working shafts, unsafe timber, and several routes that have been crossed out in red wax.

bunkhouse.name: Miners' Bunkhouse
bunkhouse.description: Tiered bunks crowd beneath a low timber roof. Wet boots line the stove, and each bed has a small shelf for a lamp, a keepsake, and the things a miner wants close when the weather shuts the road.
